designationHistory.indexText: Fox River National Wildlife Refuge in Wisconsin was formally established in spring 1979, when the Fish and Wildlife Service acquired a marsh property under a federal consent decree.

authority.citation: Land acquisition under a consent decree

designationHistory.note: FWS only, and the CCP also says in one passage that the refuge was established in 1977.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Horicon and Fox River NWRs Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2007 (ServCat 5985)
